name: OxZygen
author: 3dthc
summary: A dark, cinematic instrument: choirs, winds, brass, strings, bells, piano, e-piano, harp, mallets, synths and textures from CC0 recordings, in two layered slots with filter, lo-fi, tempo-synced delay and motion, reverb and sub. 200 presets with a browser page; a CRT orb reacts as you play. Also a VST3 for Mac and Windows and an Audio Unit for Mac.
